data.name: Connection.Intro
data.value: Pair WayfarerMobile or connect GPS loggers and other apps to your Wayfarer account.

data.name: Connection.TokenHelp
data.value: A connection token (API token) lets a trusted app read and change your data through the supported Wayfarer APIs. Keep it private. It is separate from your password, two-factor authentication and personal provider keys.

data.name: Connection.ReplaceWarning
data.value: Replacing this token stops phones and other apps from using it. Connect each one again with the new token.

data.name: Connection.RevealHelp
data.value: Copy or scan now. This token can only be shown once.

data.name: Connection.RecoveryHelp
data.value: Copy or scan before selecting Done or leaving this page. Hiding the token leaves apps connected. If you lose or expose it, replace it and reconnect your apps.

data.name: Connection.MobileHelp
data.value: Use Scan QR Code in the app's setup wizard, or enter the server address and token manually.

data.name: Connection.LoggerHelp
data.value: GPSLogger for Android by mendhak can send locations using this token. Apps that can send a custom HTTPS JSON request with an Authorization header may also be able to send locations.

data.name: Connection.LoggerGuide
data.value: Use GPS loggers and other apps

data.name: Connection.RefreshRequired
data.value: Refresh this page to check connection token status before trying again.

data.name: Connection.Unconfirmed
data.value: No token can be shown. The request may have completed and stopped apps using the old token. Checking status. Choose replacement explicitly if needed.

data.name: Connection.PendingHide
data.value: The request may already have completed. Checking status before another action.

data.name: Connection.CopyFailed
data.value: Copy was unavailable. Select and copy the displayed value manually.

data.name: Connection.HttpsRequired
data.value: HTTPS is required to connect apps. The instance or proxy configuration needs correction.
